milestones.title: Horizon Preview Bridge
milestones.summary: Use Horizon's own agent control (horizon-ctl) to launch an isolated test session, capture screenshots and read game state.

acceptance: Never touches personal worlds or accounts
Timeouts and cancellation leave no running game
A screenshot alone is never recorded as proof that a mod loaded
game-load needs package items confirmed in real inventory slots; lying, ambiguous or malformed replies never count

evidence.ref: Against stand-ins for horizon-ctl and horizon-client: Launch API check, approval, isolated game and home folders, --dev-mod package, screenshot, state, content confirmed by the game, safe end on every failure, evidence levels (tests/test_preview_bridge.py)

PB-001 strict content check against the upstream inventory schema (3c1d4b39): only package-defined ids, a control id the game must refuse, an exact +1 in real slots with counts cross-checked, polling for the server's update; lying, ambiguous and malformed stand-ins (give succeeding with nothing added, ids in components, prefixed ids, wrong quantities, 8-slot hotbars, duplicate slots, mismatched counts, list replies, any-id games) never reach game-load; evidence bound to package, build and session; ownership-checked process stop (tests/test_preview_bridge.py)
Session steps mapped to horizon-ctl at 3c1d4b39; what the evidence may claim; no real client driven yet

milestones.missing: No real Horizon client driven yet: needs an authorized installation (the same blocker as HS-002), so game-load is not reached
